about.title: Systems Engineer specialized in Data, AI and Scalable Technology Solutions
about.description:
I am a Systems Engineer and Master's graduate in Data Science with experience in machine learning, advanced analytics and large-scale data processing.

My profile combines software development, data engineering and predictive modeling to build solutions focused on solving real-world problems.

I have worked with cloud technologies, distributed processing and anomaly detection, especially in projects related to Big Data and applied cybersecurity.

responsibilities: Developed machine learning models for predictive analytics and pattern detection.
Built data processing and transformation pipelines.
Performed exploratory data analysis (EDA) to identify business opportunities and relevant patterns.
Designed dashboards and reports to support decision-making processes.
Processed large-scale datasets using BigQuery and Google Cloud Platform.
Collaborated with multidisciplinary teams on data-driven projects.
Supported and developed web and backend solutions.
Developed applications and functional prototypes using FlutterFlow.
Implemented business logic and data management functionalities.

items.title: Intelligent Cyberattack Detection System for Connected Vehicles
items.category: Master Thesis | Big Data & Machine Learning
items.problem: Detect cyberattacks in connected vehicles through large-scale CAN Bus signal analysis.
solution: Built an end-to-end pipeline for CAN Bus data processing and analysis.
Processed more than 17 million records using distributed processing with PySpark.
Trained supervised and unsupervised models for detecting DoS, spoofing and fuzzing attacks.
Applied feature engineering and class balancing techniques.
Performed anomaly detection and behavioral pattern analysis using Machine Learning.

items.title: Decision Support System for Returning to In-Person Activities
items.problem: Support decision-making for a safe return to in-person activities during the COVID-19 pandemic.
solution: Designed a system based on health and capacity criteria.
Modeled logical rules for risk assessment.
Developed a prototype focused on real-world scenarios.
